title: Artifact Lifecycle Lab: Replication Package for Measuring Reference Integrity in Coding-Agent Instruction Files (An Audited Longitudinal Study)
description:
Replication package for the manuscript Measuring Reference Integrity in Coding-Agent Instruction Files: An Audited Longitudinal Study, prepared for Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE).

Zenodo version 1.1.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21716211) archives the frozen scientific evidence used by that manuscript: longitudinal panel exports (RQ1-RQ4), the RQ2 failure audit, the born-stale taxonomy and GFC filter outputs, exploratory RQ5 A/B/C ledgers, claim-to-evidence mapping, protocols, and Makefile regeneration targets for observational analyses. The 2026-07-31 validation extension (blinded RQ2 second-auditor package, independent human labels for Person 1/Person 2/Person 3, audit-rule sensitivity, repository-concentration analyses) is included. Do not silently replace v1.0.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21711432).

Editorial rewriting of the manuscript for EMSE (template, section order, Related Work, GFC filter wording) did not change the frozen scientific content of this deposit.

Historical TOSEM-era titles and venue wording may remain in frozen release notes and freeze documents inside the package; those files record how v1.1.0 was created.

Authors: César Andrés (corresponding); David Martín-Moncunill.

Primary entry point: REPLICATION.md. Authoritative claim inventory: docs/SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_FREEZE.md. Validation protocol: docs/VALIDATION_EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md.

RQ5 agent reruns require Claude Code CLI credentials and are not bit-identically regenerable; use committed ledgers for manuscript numbers.

Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21711431.
